exact_statement: For every finite nonempty simple graph edge-prime table, both endpoint orders, and one common feasible weight 0<lambda<=1 with pi=1/4 and D=(1+lambda/4)^|E|-1, every nonempty output set A consisting of incident vertices admits a distinct actual source-SCC-rooted queue event with original probability at least (lambda/72)^|A|/D. This includes all root rarities and exclusions, block subsets, child counts, attachment compositions, fixed chronology and child labels. Any number of roots is allowed. Therefore the complete all-partitions output mass is at least this amount. This is a mass lower bound/cost upper bound, not a lower certificate for the variational infimum.
hypotheses: Uniform physical cube; cost in bits and actual Boolean squared Fourier spectrum
Both endpoint orders, width-two positive-edge prime table, original nonempty-conditioned all-partitions queue
A single globally fixed packing-feasible weight vector; all original root exclusions, selected subsets, counts, attachments and labels paid
Every selected output coordinate is incident to some table edge; positive common lambda

proof_dependencies.use: original queue probabilities and partition admissibility; locally reconstructed event

exact_statement: For all integers 2<=a<=b and 0<=k<=a, let G be K_(a,b) with k disjoint matching edges deleted and f_G its actual uniform Boolean edge DNF. On precisely its surviving positive edge primes, fix both endpoint orders, pi=1/4 and lambda_e=1/b. For the SAME original all-partitions queue, D=(1+1/(4b))^(ab-k)-1 and complete nonempty output cost C=sum_(A!=empty) fhat_G(A)^2 log2(1/Q_G(A)), there is an explicit distinct-run subfamily of complete cost less than1255I(f_G)/72<18I(f_G), hence the full queue cost and any variational infimum containing this admissible representation obey that upper bound. The result includes all root/leaf factors, arbitrary growing k, and the leafless subfamily a,b>=3. No added primes, private leaves, controller, sampled-set weights, optimal-weight claim, or arbitrary-deletion transfer is used.
